mapper.insert: INSERT INTO post (board_type, user_id, status_id, category_id, priority, assigned_user_id, title, content) VALUES ( #{boardType}, #{userId}, #{statusId, jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{categoryId, jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{priority, jdbcType=TINYINT}, #{assignedUserId, jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{title}, #{content} )
mapper.select: SELECT p.*, u.name as authorName, u.role as authorRole, c.company_name as authorCompany, cat.category_name as categoryName, a.name as assignedUserName FROM post p LEFT JOIN user u ON p.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN company c ON u.company_id = c.company_id LEFT JOIN post_category cat ON p.category_id = cat.category_id LEFT JOIN user a ON p.assigned_user_id = a.user_id WHERE p.post_id = #{postId} AND p.is_deleted = false
mapper.update: UPDATE post SET status_id = #{statusId}, category_id = #{categoryId}, priority = #{priority}, assigned_user_id = #{assignedUserId}, title = #{title}, content = #{content} WHERE post_id = #{postId}
